title: Fix unknown-height route bitrate cap
summary: Use the configured 1080p route bitrate cap when source height is unknown, matching the existing unknown-height 1080p bucket evidence and restoring the media route selection reliability gate.
reason: The reliability wrapper was blocked by route selection: unknown-height media was labeled as the 1080p bucket but still used the legacy generic movie/TV bitrate cap, so an unknown-height movie over the configured 1080p cap could incorrectly remux.
behavior_before: Unknown-height media reported route_bitrate_bucket=1080p, but Resolve-MediaRouteResolutionBitrateSelection used MovieRouteMaxVideoBitrateMbps or TVRouteMaxVideoBitrateMbps for the threshold instead of Route1080pMaxVideoBitrateMbps.
behavior_after: Unknown-height media still reports the 1080p bucket and now uses Route1080pMaxVideoBitrateMbps as the bitrate threshold for movie and TV decisions.
